 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinals will be played this week in the November international break. Each quarterfinal matchup will be played over two legs, and the winners of these four matchups will be in the Final Four in March.
 Curaçao will host Panama today for the first leg of their quarterfinal matchup, and the game will be played at Stadion Ergilio Hato in Willemstad, Curaçao.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Curaçao reached the quarterfinals after topping their CONCACAF Nations League qualifier group with 10 points after four matches played. Curaçao's record after four games was three wins and one draw.
 In their final group game, Curaçao drew 1-1 with Trinidad and Tobago away from home; Jordi Paulina scored the equalizer for Curaçao.
 Panama did not play in the CONCACAF Nations League qualifiers as they are the 4th-best-ranked CONCACAF team in the FIFA rankings.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In the previous international break, Panama played three friendly matches and all three games ended in draws. Panama played India, New Zealand, and Ecuador. Panama participated in the 2026 Kirin Cup in Japan, where they played New Zealand and Ecuador.
 Panama drew 1-1 with New Zealand but lost 5-3 on penalties. Panama then drew 1-1 with Ecuador but won the penalty shootout 7-6 to clinch 3rd place in this friendly competition.
 Koji Watanabe / Getty Images

 Where to Watch Curaçao vs. Panama – CONCACAF Nations League Quarterfinals 
 Curaçao vs. Panama kicks off at 7:30 P.M. ET / 4:30 P.M. PT in the United States. The match kicks off at 8:30 P.M. local time at Stadion Ergilio Hato in Willemstad, Curaçao.
 The match will be available to watch in the United States and in other countries through select TV channels and streaming services.
 FOX, FS2, FOX One, ViX, Fubo Sports, Fox Sports Online (USA)
 Rush Sports, TV Direct 13, Concacaf App, Concacaf YouTube Channel (Curaçao)
 Fox, Fox+, Tubi, Fox YouTube (Panama)
